ribbon.saveTip: Saves the document together with its annotations and form values.
ribbon.saveFormTip: Saves the form values you filled in to the file.
ribbon.printTip: Prints the pages with annotations and form values.
ribbon.copyTip: Copies the selected text to the clipboard.
ribbon.selectTip: Returns to selecting text and following links.
ribbon.highlightTip: Highlights text you select; drag over empty space for a free-hand highlight.
ribbon.addTextTip: Adds permanent text to the page: click a spot on the page and type. Turkish characters are supported.
ribbon.findTip: Searches the document (ignoring case and the I/İ/ı/i difference).
ribbon.freeTextTip: Adds a movable text annotation to the page.
ribbon.stampTip: Adds a movable image (stamp) to the page.
ribbon.colorTip: Color of the active tool (text box, drawing, highlight) or of the selected annotation.
ribbon.commentTip: Adds or edits the comment of the selected annotation.
ribbon.deletePagesTip: Deletes the selected pages (or the current page).
ribbon.duplicatePagesTip: Inserts a copy of each selected page right after it.
ribbon.insertBlankTip: Inserts a blank page of the same size after the selected page.
ribbon.addImageTip: Adds a picture as page content: choose the file, then click where it goes on the page.
ribbon.mergeTip: Appends the pages of other PDF files to the end of this document.
ribbon.extractTip: Saves the selected pages as a new PDF file.
ribbon.previousFieldTip: Moves to the previous form field.
ribbon.nextFieldTip: Moves to the next form field.
ribbon.thumbnailsTip: Shows or hides the page thumbnails panel.
ribbon.rotateViewTip: Rotates only the view on screen; the file does not change.

status.zoom: Zoom {{value}}%; click to fit the page width

content.addText: Add text: click on the page
content.addImage: Add image: click on the page

thumbnails.hint: Drag, or use Alt+↑/↓, to reorder.

hints.addText: Click where the text should start (Enter: top left of the current page, Esc: cancel).
hints.addImage: Click where the image's top-left corner should go (Enter: top left of the current page, Esc: cancel).

password.title: Password required

addText.title: Add text

deletePages.message_other: {{count}} pages will be deleted ({{pages}}). The original file does not change until you save.

link.title: External link

link.copied: The link was copied to the clipboard.

notices.replaceUnsupported: Replacing text is not supported in PDF documents; you can search only.
notices.selectAnnotationFirst: Select an annotation first (highlight, text box, drawing or image) — turn on one of the annotation tools and click the item.
notices.atStart: The selected pages are already at the start of the document.
notices.atEnd: The selected pages are already at the end of the document.
notices.chooseToolForColor: Choose an annotation tool first (Highlight, Text box or Draw) to change its color.
notices.noFields: This document has no fillable form fields.
notices.merged: The pages of the chosen PDF files were added to the end of the document.
notices.placeImage: The image is ready. Click where its top-left corner should go on the page.

errors.extractSameFile: Extracted pages cannot be saved over the open document's own file; choose another name.
errors.printNothing: There are no pages to print.
errors.open: The PDF could not be opened.
